_comment: Custom per-edit patterns for the security-guidance plugin. Deterministic string/regex
matches run on every Edit/Write with no model call, so this layer is free.
JSON rather than YAML on purpose: the plugin needs PyYAML importable to read a .yaml
file and silently ignores it otherwise, while the .json form works on any Python.
Additive: the plugin's built-in patterns still fire. Cap is 50 rules.
Regexes are Python syntax, matched against the edited content.
'paths' globs match the full file path, so project-relative patterns need a ** prefix.

patterns.reminder: Hardcoded credential prefix. Load it from the environment or a secret store; never commit a literal key (master-core module 60).

unsafe block. Module 50 requires an immediately preceding // SAFETY: comment stating the invariant relied on and who guarantees it (pointer validity, length, lifetime, null-termination). Add one if it is missing.
unwrap/expect directly on a parse or I/O result. If this value can originate outside the process, return a typed error instead: module 60 forbids panicking on untrusted input.
Unsafe deserialization. pickle/marshal execute arbitrary code on load; yaml.load without SafeLoader does too. Use json, or yaml.safe_load.
Shell execution with a composed string. Pass an argument list and shell=False so caller-controlled data cannot become a command.
SQL assembled by concatenation or interpolation. Module 50 requires an ORM, query builder, or parameterized statements.
DOM injection or dynamic code execution sink. If any part of this value is caller-controlled it is an XSS/RCE path; render as text or sanitize at the boundary.
Possible secret reaching a log or error message. Module 60: errors state what failed plus a correlation ID, never the sensitive value.
TLS certificate verification disabled. This silently converts every connection into an interceptable one; scope it to a test fixture or remove it.

Workflow edit touching permissions, secrets, or checkout. Workflow files grant repository-level access; confirm the trigger cannot run untrusted code with write scope (pull_request_target plus a PR checkout is the classic escalation).
CI action pinned to a mutable ref. Pin to an immutable commit digest, as this repo's ci.yml already does for actionlint.
Filesystem path built from caller-controlled input. Normalize and confine to an allowed root before opening.
